Tyrell Harper: Hi all — Tyrell here, excited to join Platform/Infra today (PST). Quick checklist: I need MDM + laptop image, VPN access, and SSH permissions for our build hosts. My personal laptop is a MacBook Pro 14\" if that matters. Fun fact: I run a small boardgame meetup on weekends, happy to bring games to office.

Eva Li: welcome!! :tada: People Ops should have kicked off the MDM invite — check your email and JAMF. If you don't see it, @me and I'll nudge.

Jordan Park: hey Tyrell — adding you to infra slack channels now. For SSH keys, generate and paste public key here or DM me. Quick command if needed:

```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "tyrell@redwood.ai"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
For VPN (WireGuard) follow https://intra.redwood/infra/vpn-runbook and run the onboarding script.

Sam Wells: laptop update: we shipped the company image to your address on file earlier today, should arrive in 48-72 hours. I'll share tracking in DM. Also, weekly infra standup is Tue 10am PT — invite should hit your calendar. :calendar:

InfraBot: Checklist updated — new hire added: Tyrell Harper. Items queued: MDM invite, VPN account, SSH access request.

Noah Simms: boardgames + infra = :100: Also ping me for Terraform module refs. If you want a starter repo, I can fork one for you.

Tyrell Harper: Awesome, thanks everyone. I pasted my public key in a DM to Jordan. Small follow-up: who should I ping about service account key rotation and storing creds (KMS/HSM)?

Sarah Chen: @Tyrell — security eng handles key rotation policy. I can add you to the key-rotation doc and the runbook for HSM/KMS access. Welcome aboard! :wave:
